fix: lamenting to many people and regretting
reason: οἰκτιζόμενος πρὸς πολλούς: bewailing to many; no 'victims' in Greek, and 'to many' explains how Agathocles learned of it.
γυμνός, simply 'naked'; matches the later 'saw him naked' (ὁρῶντες αὐτὸν γυμνόν).

fix: Moeragenes said that it needed only someone to take the lead.
reason: μάλιστα goes with ἀκμάζειν (already rendered); προσδεῖσθαι τῶν καταρξομένων = needed besides only those to begin. Drop misplaced 'chiefly'.

fix: because his own ship had a high-built prow
reason: Gen. abs. sits in the αὐτὸς μέν clause: Deinocrates' raised prow made the blow land above water. English assigns it to the enemy.

fix: at times it is bridged by those who wish to cross on foot between the continents, and at other times it is constantly traversed by shipping
reason: ποτὲ μὲν … ποτὲ δέ contrast lost; 'at all times' not in Greek; bridged BY (ὑπό) those crossing.
τε…καί joins two genitive absolutes; κατὰ γῆν naturally opens the second. 'Most of their supplies' is acceptable for πλείστων.
ἐφεδρεία here is the covering force sent forward to the summits; chs. 21-22 call it the Macedonian outpost. Not a rearguard.
στύπη δρύινα = oak logs/stumps (cf. Livy's stipites); 'wrapped in tow' confuses it with στύππη.
ἐκ τῆς Ἰσίνδης προσαγορευομένης πόλεως: Isinda, not Sinda.

fix: relieved the people of Isinda from the siege
reason: τοὺς Ἰσινδεῖς: people of Isinda; consistent with F0287.

fix: at the appropriate [...] season when he also paid the Romans
reason: Unmarked lacuna after ἐπιβαλλομένῳ, and ἐπιβαλλομένῳ itself dropped. Past tense fine in reported treaty.

fix: the whole issue was, in all likelihood, about to be decided
reason: λήψεσθαι τὰ ὅλα κρίσιν ἐκ τῶν κατὰ λόγον: the whole was likely to reach decision; 'by force of arms' invented and makes Perseus the subject.
ἡλικίαν τὴν τοῦ Πτολεμαίου: the youth is Ptolemy's; 'the king' after Antiochus misidentifies.
